notes_for_editor: Thin. The only tower-specific history is the fiscal 1969-70 floor entry. The Goose Creek Phillipsburg Towersite tract may be the lookout site, but no source ties the two, so the story does not say so. No build date, height, status or access source for the tower. Two web searches found nothing more. Not on NHLR or FFLOS in our caches. The story is short on purpose; do not pad it.
